panels.title: Unified Model Runtime · Live model operations

options.content:
Follow each model from **data → prediction → admission → fill → settlement**. Select one process to investigate or compare the full collection.

**Scope:** operational rates follow the selected time range. Economic and calibration aggregates cover the current instrumentation session and reset on service/model/run/config changes. They are not lifetime accounting. Missing outcomes remain **Awaiting evidence**, never artificial zeros.

panels.title: Ready processes
panels.description: Latest process readiness; feed and feature gaps recover automatically.

panels.title: Oldest inference
panels.description: Elapsed time since successful inference among processes with inference evidence. Processes awaiting their first inference are excluded. Entry schedules naturally create quiet periods.

panels.title: Inference rate
panels.description: Successful and failed inference attempts per second; inspect the error panel below.

panels.title: Session net PnL
panels.description: Net PnL recognized by authoritative settlement during this instrumentation session.

panels.title: Selected models
panels.description: Model identity is pinned by artifact and feature checksums. Discovery never changes an active selection.

panels.title: Readiness over time
panels.description: A transient unavailable input must not permanently disable the process.

panels.title: Observation heartbeat age
panels.description: Low age confirms callbacks are reaching the process even outside model entry windows.

panels.title: Scheduled opportunities
panels.description: Claimed opportunities at the configured candidate cadence. Pre-claim skips are displayed separately.

panels.title: Inferred markets
panels.description: Distinct markets with at least one prediction in the instrumentation session.

panels.title: Admitted markets
panels.description: Distinct markets admitted by the model; execution can still reject an order.

panels.title: Filled orders
panels.description: Orders acknowledged as filled by the existing execution pathway.

panels.title: Skipped opportunities by reason
panels.description: Includes absent history, persistence unavailability, duplicate candidate claims and out-of-schedule callbacks. Repeated callbacks are not distinct market opportunities.

panels.title: Persisted decision stages
panels.description: Stages are lifecycle transitions. Do not sum them as mutually exclusive outcomes.

panels.title: Market inference coverage
panels.description: Distinct inferred markets / observed markets. Current-session denominator includes observed markets without inference.

panels.title: Market admission coverage
panels.description: Distinct admitted markets / observed markets. Coverage across models overlaps and must not be summed.

panels.title: Eligible market coverage
panels.description: Inferred markets / markets with at least one claimed candidate slot. Feed outages before a candidate can be claimed are visible in observed-market coverage and skips.

panels.title: Execution transitions
panels.description: Order states from the existing execution engine, separate from persisted decision stages.

panels.title: Missing feature fraction
panels.description: Fraction of model inputs using native missing values. Optional absence remains visible; similar source names do not establish equivalence.

panels.title: Feature age
panels.description: Age of the immutable feature snapshot at the process observation time.

panels.title: Stage latency · p95
panels.description: Stages include features, inference, strategy and complete observation. Durations overlap; do not sum percentiles.

panels.title: Feature and inference errors
panels.description: Failures remain distinct from a model correctly abstaining.

panels.title: Runtime block reasons
panels.description: Shared infrastructure readiness is filtered for each process’s actual requirements.

panels.title: Telemetry capacity drops
panels.description: Dropped unresolved prediction records limit analytical coverage; operational trading continues.

panels.title: Feature failure reasons
panels.description: Controlled error categories; diagnostic detail is in the process logs.

panels.title: Inference failure reasons
panels.description: A failed score is distinct from an intentional model abstention.

panels.title: Inference latency · p50
panels.description: Inference latency percentile. Native host smoke results do not establish deployed container capacity.

panels.title: Inference latency · p99
panels.description: Inference latency percentile. Native host smoke results do not establish deployed container capacity.

panels.title: Inference failure ratio
panels.description: Failed inference attempts / all attempts in this instrumentation session.

panels.title: Feature failure ratio
panels.description: Failed feature attempts / all feature attempts in this instrumentation session.

panels.title: Latest probability · UP
panels.description: Probability of UP, independent of whether admission or execution allowed a trade.

panels.title: Latest confidence
panels.description: Maximum of UP and DOWN probability. High confidence alone does not establish good entry economics.

panels.title: Model admission decisions
panels.description: Accepted/rejected model decisions; independent of strategy, capital and execution gates.

panels.title: Admission rejection reasons
panels.description: Frozen adapter reasons distinguish cost, confidence, expected edge, learned loss and temporal disagreement.

panels.title: Learned admission probability
panels.description: Only defined for models with learned admission. Empty for programmatic models.

panels.title: Predicted loss severity
panels.description: Frozen learned output, clipped at zero exactly as training. This is not realized loss.

panels.title: Temporal probability dispersion
panels.description: Population standard deviation across the frozen predictor and temporal snapshots. Only defined for consensus models.

panels.title: Temporal direction agreement
panels.description: Fraction of frozen components agreeing with the official predictor.

panels.title: UP / DOWN / ABSTAIN
panels.description: Model actions over the selected range. Raw directional probabilities remain available for abstained candidates.

panels.title: Predicted stress edge
panels.description: Frozen learned stress-edge output per share; an estimate, not realized stress PnL.

panels.title: UP probability distribution
panels.description: Counts per decile: bin 0 is [0,0.1), bin 9 is [0.9,1]. These are inference opportunities, not independent markets.

panels.title: Confidence distribution
panels.description: Counts per decile: bin 0 is [0,0.1), bin 9 is [0.9,1]. These are inference opportunities, not independent markets.

panels.title: Strategy rejection reasons
panels.description: Existing strategy guards may reject an admitted model prediction.

panels.title: Failed observation callbacks
panels.description: Unhandled observation errors, including persistence and execution failures, retain existing recovery behavior.

panels.title: Brier score
panels.description: Mean squared probability error over resolved inference opportunities, including rejected trades. Multiple predictions per market are correlated.

panels.title: Directional correctness
panels.description: Correct resolved predictions / all resolved predictions. Not the executed-trade win rate.

panels.title: Calibration by probability bin
panels.description: Observed UP frequency for each decile. Compare with mean predicted probability; bins with no outcomes remain undefined.

panels.title: Unresolved prediction records
panels.description: Pending official outcomes retained in bounded memory. Restarts reset this operational buffer; durable feature/decision records remain.

panels.title: Calibration mean prediction
panels.description: Mean forecast probability in each resolved decile; compare with observed UP frequency.

panels.title: Calibration sample counts
panels.description: Number of resolved inference opportunities in each decile. A sparse bin cannot support a calibration conclusion.

panels.title: Resolved prediction sample count
panels.description: Evaluation-weighted denominator for Brier and correctness.

panels.title: Settled trade win rate
panels.description: Winning settlements / win-or-loss settlements; sample counts are displayed below.

targets.expr: (sum by (process_id) (polymarket_umr_trade_outcomes_total{process_id=~"$process",reason="win"}) / (sum by (process_id) (polymarket_umr_trade_outcomes_total{process_id=~"$process",reason="win"}) + sum by (process_id) (polymarket_umr_trade_outcomes_total{process_id=~"$process",reason="loss"}))) * on(process_id) group_left(model_key) polymarket_umr_model_info{process_id=~"$process"}

panels.title: Expectancy / trade
panels.description: Recognized net PnL / settled trades.

panels.title: Profit factor
panels.description: Gross positive settled PnL / absolute gross negative settled PnL.

panels.title: Wins to recover one loss
panels.description: Average absolute losing trade / average winning trade. Undefined until both exist.

targets.expr: ((polymarket_umr_gross_loss_usd{process_id=~"$process"} / sum by (process_id) (polymarket_umr_trade_outcomes_total{process_id=~"$process",reason="loss"})) / (polymarket_umr_gross_profit_usd{process_id=~"$process"} / sum by (process_id) (polymarket_umr_trade_outcomes_total{process_id=~"$process",reason="win"}))) * on(process_id) group_left(model_key) polymarket_umr_model_info{process_id=~"$process"}

panels.title: Maximum drawdown
panels.description: Peak-to-trough recognized net PnL within the current instrumentation session.

panels.title: Realized net PnL
panels.description: Net PnL from successfully recognized settlements; excludes unresolved positions.

panels.title: Settled trade outcomes
panels.description: Economic win/loss/push classification by realized net PnL.

panels.title: Average entry share price
panels.description: Actual fill notional / actual shares filled. Fees are displayed separately.

panels.title: Average entry second
panels.description: Average market age of filled entry decisions. Fill-event weighted.

panels.title: Quote-to-fill slippage / share
panels.description: Actual fill minus executable quote at decision time, weighted by shares. Positive is adverse.

panels.title: Actual fill fees
panels.description: Fees reported by fills in the current session.

panels.title: Settled fees
panels.description: Entry fees associated with settlements recognized during this session; differs from fees on still-open fills.

panels.title: Registered telemetry capacity drops
panels.description: Global registration capacity losses, repeated per selected process for visibility. Capacity losses never authorize or block orders.

panels.title: Observation book failure causes
panels.description: Book selection failures per side at the immutable observation boundary. Distinguishes timestamp, identity, epoch and integrity failures; these counts are not model admission rejections.

panels.title: Process lifecycle and diagnostics
panels.description: Process IDs remain structured fields rather than Loki stream labels. This panel also includes existing process-scoped runtime diagnostics.
